messages.subject: itemfit (empirical.plot)
parts:
Hi all,

I have a total of 72 items and three groups, each one answering a specific test ), such that:

Items 1-22: presented only to group 1
Items 23-30: presented to groups 1 and 2
Items 31-42: presented only to group 2
Items 43-52: presented to groups 2 and 3
Items 53-72: presented only to group 3


I am doing a multiple groups analysis with the following codes:

model.prior <- mirt.model('F1 = 1-72
                         CONSTRAINB = (23-30,43-52,a1),
                          (23-30,43-52,d),
                          (23-30,43-52,g)
                          PRIOR = (1-72, a1, lnorm, 1,1),
                          (1-72, d, norm, 0, 3),
                          (1-72, g, norm, -1.1,1.1)')
resultML3P<-multipleGroup(mYmirt, model=model.prior ,
                          group = vgrupo,itemtype='3PL',
              SE=TRUE,method='EM',TOL=0.0001,quadpts=40,
              invariance=c('free_means',
                           'free_var','slopes','intercepts'))

rthetaML3P <- fscores(resultML3P,method='EAP',full.scores.SE=TRUE)[,1]

where "mYirt" is the binary matrix (with NA, since not all subjects answer all items).  When I run:

itemfit(resultML3P,group.bins = 10,empirical.plot = 1,Theta=matrix(rthetaML3P))

I've got:

Error in if (x [1] == 0) 0 else qbeta (alpha, x [1], x [2] - x [1] + 1):
   missing value where TRUE / FALSE required

Coud anyone help me?

Best,

Caio
